<a id="page-animation"></a>
# Motion

Entrances and loops (`animate=`), animations with tracks, transitions of a changing value, and the motion keys.
Open it when a line moves, fades, springs or follows a value over time.

<a id="animation-the-animate-words"></a>
## The animate words

`animate=<word>` on any line plays a preset; `duration`, `delay` (milliseconds) beside it, and under an `each`,
`stagger` (each copy that much later).

```notation
Column w=40 h=40 fill=#FFE5E7EB animate=fade duration=400
```

| `animate=` | Preset | Params |
|---|---|---|
| `fade` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0}}}` |
| `fade-up` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"translateY":16}}}` |
| `slide` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"translateY":16}}}` |
| `slide-up` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"translateY":16}}}` |
| `slide-down` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"translateY":-16}}}` |
| `slide-left` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"translateX":24}}}` |
| `slide-right` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"translateX":-24}}}` |
| `scale` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"scale":0.9}}}` |
| `zoom` | `enter` | `{"params":{"from":{"opacity":0,"scale":0.9}}}` |
| `pulse` | `pulse` | `{"params":{"scaleFrom":1,"scaleTo":1.06,"opacityFrom":1,"opacityTo":0.7}}` |
| `spin` | `spin` |  |
| `bob` | `bob` |  |
| `sway` | `sway` |  |
| `pop` | `pop` | `{"autoplay":true}` |
| `bounce` | `bounce` | `{"autoplay":true}` |
| `shake` | `shake` | `{"autoplay":true}` |
| `wiggle` | `wiggle` | `{"autoplay":true}` |
| `flash` | `flash` | `{"autoplay":true}` |
| `shimmer` | `shimmer` |  |

<a id="animation-animation-lines"></a>
## Animation lines

Any other animation is an `animation#id` line under its node, with its fields by name; its tracks are `track`
lines under it (a track animates one path of the node, a variable, or another node's).

```notation
Column w=40 h=40 fill=#FFE5E7EB
  animation#enter duration=520 curve=easeOutCubic
    track path=opacity from=0 to=1
    track path=motion.translateY from=14 to=0
```

The `animate` action plays, reverses or sets one: `onTap={animate node=card command=forward}`.

<a id="animation-an-animation-s-fields"></a>
### An animation's fields

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | `""` |  |
| `preset` | text |  | A short form (`AnimationPresets`); its params below. |
| `params` | JSON |  |  |
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `duration` | whole number |  | Milliseconds; empty: the preset's, else 300. |
| `reverseDuration` | whole number |  | `AnimationController.duration` / `reverseDuration` (ms); null: the preset's, else 300. |
| `delay` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` |  |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) |  |  |
| `repeat` | [AnimationRepeat](values.md#type-AnimationRepeat) |  | `repeat(reverse:, count:)`; null: the preset's, else plays once. |
| `autoplay` | `true`/`false` |  | Plays when the node appears; false waits for `playKey` or an action. Null: the preset's, else true. |
| `playKey` | text |  | A change plays it from the start (bindable). |
| `paused` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Holds the controller where it is (`stop()`) while true; it carries on when false. Held before it starts, it waits at its start. Bindable. |
| `phase` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0` | Where a play starts in its cycle (0–1). |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) |  |  |
| `progress` | text |  | An expression giving its value (0–1) instead of a clock. |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) |  | The point the scale and rotation of its adding and multiplying tracks are about (`ScaleTransition(alignment:)`); null: the preset's, else the center. |
| `tracks` | list of [AnimationTrack](values.md#type-AnimationTrack) | `[]` |  |
| `previewAt` | number |  | Where the design canvas draws it (a share of a cycle); empty: not applied there. |
| `ramp` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Ms to speed up from still, and to slow to a stop when paused. |
| `visibleFraction` | number |  | Waits to start until this share of the node is in view. |

<a id="animation-transitions"></a>
## Transitions

A `transition` line under a node animates a change of one of its values (a binding, a media rule):

```notation
Column w=40 h=40 fill=#FFE5E7EB
  transition property=opacity duration=200 curve=easeOut
```

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `property` | text | `""` | A binding path or a prefix of one (`motion`, `motion.rotate`, `opacity`); `*` for every path. |
| `duration` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` |  |
| `delay` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` |  |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) | `linear` |  |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) |  |  |
| `keyframes` | list of [Keyframe](values.md#type-Keyframe) | `[]` |  |
| `interpolation` | `linear` `monotoneCubic` | `linear` |  |

<a id="animation-behaviors"></a>
## Keys any line takes here

<a id="behavior-motion"></a>
### `motion` (behavior)

The transform over the layout (Flutter's `Transform`): its move, scale and rotation are drawn, never laid out.

Written `motion={…}` on any line ([Motion](#type-Motion)). Level 4.
 Each field of its record (Motion) is a key of its own, dotted: `motion.translateX=…`.

<a id="type-Motion"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motion.translateX` | number | `0` | Pixels. |
| `motion.translateY` | number | `0` | Pixels (`Transform.translate(offset:)`). |
| `motion.shiftX` | number | `0` | Times the node's size (`FractionalTranslation`). |
| `motion.shiftY` | number | `0` | Multiples of the node's own size (`FractionalTranslation`). |
| `motion.scale` | number | `1` | The axis factors multiply `scale`. |
| `motion.scaleX` | number | `1` | `Transform.scale(scale:, scaleX:, scaleY:)`: the axis factors multiply `scale`. |
| `motion.scaleY` | number | `1` | `Transform.scale(scale:, scaleX:, scaleY:)`: the axis factors multiply `scale`. |
| `motion.rotate` | number | `0` | Degrees, about z. |
| `motion.rotateX` | number | `0` | Degrees, in 3D. |
| `motion.rotateY` | number | `0` | Degrees. `rotate` turns about z (`Transform.rotate`); `rotateX` and `rotateY` turn in 3D, seen with `perspective` (0 flat). |
| `motion.perspective` | number | `1` | How strongly a 3D rotation is seen in depth (0 flat). |
| `motion.alignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | `[0,0]` | The point scale and rotation are about (`Transform.alignment`). |
| `motion.backfaceHidden` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Not painted while its back faces the viewer (through every transform above it too). |
| `motion.path` | [PathFollow](values.md#type-PathFollow) |  | A path the node sits on. |

Written `animations=[…]` on any line (list of [NodeAnimation](#type-NodeAnimation), default `[]`). Level 4.

<a id="animation-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-NodeAnimation"></a>
### NodeAnimation

One `AnimationController` on a node and the tweens it drives (behavior key `animations`, a list). A screen-wide one sits on the canvas node.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | `""` | Unique on the node; what `animate` and `${animation.<id>}` name. |
| `preset` | text |  | A short form (`AnimationPresets`); its params below. |
| `params` | JSON |  |  |
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Off, it applies nothing and doesn't run (the node shows its own values). Bindable. |
| `duration` | whole number |  | Milliseconds; empty: the preset's, else 300. |
| `reverseDuration` | whole number |  | `AnimationController.duration` / `reverseDuration` (ms); null: the preset's, else 300. |
| `delay` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Waits this long (ms) before each play starts; the value holds at its start meanwhile. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) |  | Applied to the controller's value before every track; null: the preset's, else linear. |
| `repeat` | [AnimationRepeat](values.md#type-AnimationRepeat) |  | `repeat(reverse:, count:)`; null: the preset's, else plays once. |
| `autoplay` | `true`/`false` |  | Plays when the node appears; false waits for `playKey` or an action. Null: the preset's, else true. |
| `playKey` | text |  | A change plays it from the start (bindable). |
| `paused` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Holds the controller where it is (`stop()`) while true; it carries on when false. Held before it starts, it waits at its start. Bindable. |
| `phase` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0` | Where a play starts in its cycle (0–1). |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) |  | Runs on this spring instead of `duration` and `curve`: `animateWith(SpringSimulation(spring, 0, 1, 0))`. |
| `progress` | text |  | An expression giving its value (0–1) instead of a clock. |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) |  | The point the scale and rotation of its adding and multiplying tracks are about (`ScaleTransition(alignment:)`); null: the preset's, else the center. |
| `tracks` | list of [AnimationTrack](values.md#type-AnimationTrack) | `[]` |  |
| `previewAt` | number |  | Where the design canvas draws it (a share of a cycle); empty: not applied there. |
| `ramp` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Ms to speed up from still, and to slow to a stop when paused. |
| `visibleFraction` | number |  | Waits to start until this share of the node is in view. |

<a id="type-Transition"></a>
### Transition

How a change of `property` animates (Flutter's implicit animations: `AnimatedContainer(duration:, curve:)`, `AnimatedOpacity`, `AnimatedScale`, `TweenAnimationBuilder`): when the value there changes (a binding, a condition, a state style), the node tweens from what it shows to the new value over `duration` after `delay` on `curve`, or on `spring`. A change mid-flight carries on from where it is. A behavior key, a list: `"transitions": [{"property": "motion", "duration": 240, "curve": "easeOutCubic"}, {"property": "opacity", "duration": 120}]`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `property` | text | `""` | A binding path or a prefix of one (`motion`, `motion.rotate`, `opacity`); `*` for every path. |
| `duration` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Milliseconds. |
| `delay` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Milliseconds. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) | `linear` |  |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) |  | Replaces `duration` and `curve`. |
| `keyframes` | list of [Keyframe](values.md#type-Keyframe) | `[]` | Values passed through on the way (`Keyframe`s, `at` 0–1 of the run): a number for a single property; for a prefix, an object of the numbers under it (`{"at": 0.5, "value": {"scale": 1.05}}`: a card that swells as it turns over). Joined as `interpolation` says. |
| `interpolation` | `linear` `monotoneCubic` | `linear` |  |

## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="animation-example-pages-animation-json"></a>
### pages/animation.json

From [`pages/animation.json`](../animation.md).

```notation
state done=false
canvas h=120
Row#row gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":120} crossAxisAlignment=null
  box#check w=32 h=32 fills=[{"color":"#FFE5E7EB"}] fill={done ? '#FF16A34A' : '#FFE5E7EB'} radius=16 motion.scale={done ? 1.15 : 1} onTap={setVariable variable=done op=toggle}
    transition property=motion duration=250 curve=easeOutBack
    transition property=decoration duration=200
  Text#label "Drink water" size=17 w={"fill":280} h={"hug":22} opacity={done ? 0.5 : 1}
    transition property=opacity duration=200
```

### animation.md: animations

From [animation.md](../animation.md) (the block at line 51 of its template, pages/animation.md); its keys on a `box`.

```notation
box#example
  animation#enter duration=600 curve=easeOut visibleFraction=0.3
    track path=opacity from=0 to=1

```

From [animation.md](../animation.md) (the block at line 76 of its template, pages/animation.md); its document keys, and its other keys on the screen.

```notation
state trees:decimal=0
```
